title: Bookings, pipelines, membership tiers, Collaborators hosted and people per Journey are counted at their write paths
detail: PHASE 2 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. These five meters are display-only today: nothing counts them, so the 2026-12-01 switch would enforce nothing. Each write path counts and asks the write seam (spaceAllowanceVerdict) before adding one. A full meter stops the next write and never hides what exists.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+"/"+f.name;if(f.isDirectory()){if(f.name!=="node_modules")walk(p,o)}else if(/\.tsx?$/.test(f.name)&&!/\.test\./.test(f.name))o.push(p)}return o};const src=[...walk("lib"),...walk("app")].filter((f)=>!f.startsWith("lib/pricing/")).map((f)=>[f,r(f)]);const usedAt=(k,seam)=>src.some(([f,s])=>s.includes(JSON.stringify(k).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(39)))&&seam.test(s));const seam=/spaceAllowance(Verdict|Headroom)\(/;const miss=["space_bookings","space_multi_pipeline","space_membership_tiers","space_collaborators","space_journey"].filter((k)=>!usedAt(k,seam));if(miss.length)fail("no write path counts: "+miss.join(","));console.log("ok: the five display-only meters are counted where they are written")'
